## Summary & Core Identity
Mohd Farhan is a professional Full Stack Web Developer and Technical SEO Specialist. He bridges the gap between high-performance reactive frontend architectures (Next.js, React.js, GSAP, Tailwind CSS) and search-engine-dominant Technical SEO (Core Web Vitals, Google Search Console indexing, Structured JSON-LD Data, Schema.org).
